props.name: Payment application
props.meaning: the farmer's yearly application for direct payments (aid application / payment claim); its decision and payment steps

props.name: Entitlement application
props.meaning: application for the allocation of payment entitlements under the basic payment scheme

props.name: Parcel document
props.meaning: the farmer's declaration of agricultural parcels (2015 format)

props.name: Geo parcel document
props.meaning: the farmer's geo-spatial declaration of agricultural parcels (2016–2017 format)

props.name: Reference alignment
props.meaning: cross-check of declared parcels against the reference parcels of the identification system for agricultural parcels

props.name: Control summary
props.meaning: summary of the administrative checks and their results for the application

props.name: Department control parcels
props.meaning: parcel checks carried out by the local department

props.name: Inspection
props.meaning: on-the-spot checks, either on site or by remote sensing
